name: Volcanic & aviation ash
summary: Mayon in the Philippines remains at Alert Level 3; no red aviation codes on major air routes
state: Mayon in the Philippines remains at Alert Level 3 with ash emissions and Strombolian activity (GMA News). VolcanoDiscovery's 2 Nov round-up lists activity at Fuego, Semeru, Ibu, Dukono and Sangay, all routine for those volcanoes. No volcano near major international air routes was at aviation colour code red and no large explosive eruption was reported as of 7 Nov.
for_you: Air travellers to affected areas can check with their airline; follow local civil-defence advice near active volcanoes.
rubric_hit: No colour code red, no large eruption = Normal

sources.title: GMA News — Phivolcs: Strombolian activity, lava fountaining at Mayon

why: Major eruptions ground flights (Iceland 2010) and can cool the climate for years.
drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
